component.name: Whodis
component.summary: Inspect domain registration, DNS, services, and technology stacks

description.p: Whodis is a readable WHOIS alternative for the RDAP era. It discovers the appropriate RDAP, WHOIS, or RWhois authority and combines that data with DNS inventory, bounded diagnostics, and evidence-backed technology and infrastructure profiling.

The native desktop application provides registration, DNS query, resolver comparison, delegation, web, TLS, mail, stack, related-domain, findings, batch, and raw-source views without requiring the command-line application.
